ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Primary AML/CFT framework: Ley 526 de 1999 (creates the UIAF – Unidad de Información y Análisis Financiero), Ley 1121 de 2006 (counter-terrorism offences), Ley 1762 de 2015 (anti-smuggling AML), Ley 2155 de 2021 (Art. 12 establishes the mandatory beneficial ownership register), Decreto 830 de 2021 (regulates the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales – RUBF), Resolución DIAN 000164 de 2023 (RUBF procedural rules, 10% ownership/control/profit threshold; 5% for fiduciary/trust structures), and Circular Básica Jurídica 034 de 2019 of the Superintendencia de Sociedades (mandatory AML risk management system – SAGRILAFT). Corporate existence and legal representation are governed by Código de Comercio Articles 98–120 and Ley 1258 de 2008.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Charter / Deed of Incorporation (Documento Privado de Constitución or Escritura Pública if real property is contributed)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Colombian Notaría Pública for notarized execution; for foreign shareholders, executed before their home notary and apostilled
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille Convention (Colombia member since 2001) applied by the competent authority of the country of origin; Consular Legalization only for non-Hague Convention states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over the S.A.S. registered office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic evidentiary document issued by the chamber; Apostille only if subsequently exported for foreign bank or client due diligence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing and constitutional documents of each foreign corporate shareholder (Certificado de Vigencia / Extracto del Registro Mercantil extranjero)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign Companies Registry (e.g., Companies House, Delaware Division of Corporations, etc.)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille from the foreign state followed by certified translation into Spanish before the Cámara de Comercio for filing

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport copies and PEP / UBO declarations of directors, legal representatives, and ultimate beneficial owners (Declaración de Beneficiario Final y Autorización de Tratamiento de Datos)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized signatures before a Colombian notary; foreign notarized copies must be apostilled

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO filing in the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUBF) via the DIAN digital portal
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Electronic filing authenticated with the legal representative's digital signature; no apostille required, but underlying notarized/UBO declarations must be retained for tax and AML audit

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-signature and quarterly-recurring screening of all shareholders, directors, legal representatives, and UBOs against: (i) the UN Security Council Consolidated List (Resolutions 1267/1989/2253/1988), (ii) the OFAC SDN List and sectoral sanctions, (iii) the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, (iv) Colombian national lists (UIAF terrorist financing list, Consejo Nacional de Política Criminal Resolución 009 de 2022), and (v) adverse media review. Politically Exposed Persons, including heads of state, ministers, judges, high-ranking military officers, and their close associates, trigger enhanced due diligence per Circular Básica Jurídica 034 de 2019. Screening results and underlying UBO documentation must be archived in the compliance file for ten years and made available to DIAN, UIAF, or the Superintendencia de Sociedades upon request.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Ventanilla Única Empresarial (VUE) and Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES), operated by the Cámaras de Comercio (www.vue.gov.co / www.rues.org.co; Bogotá regional portal www.ccb.org.co); name conflict pre-check is filed electronically and issued by the local Cámara de Comercio.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name must include the Spanish legal type suffix 'S.A.S.' as the final element. The distinctive fantasy element may be in Spanish or in a foreign language written in Latin script; non-Latin scripts (Cyrillic, Arabic, logographic characters such as Chinese) must be transliterated into an approved Romanized form for registration. Descriptive generic words alone are rejected; the name must contain at least one distinctive and identifiable element that is phonetically pronounceable in Spanish and consistent with public policy and good morals.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Financiera, Sociedad Financiera, Fondo de Inversión
Bolsa de Valores, Comisionista de Bolsa
Petróleos, Gas, Minera, Hidrocarburos (requires prior ANH / Ministry authorization)
Municipal, Distrital, Nacional, Presidencial, Gobierno, Policía, Ejército
Cruz Roja, Interpol, ONU, OEA (international organization names)
Términos contrarios a la ley, la moral y las buenas costumbres
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon administrative rejection of the proposed name, the applicant may file a reconsideration appeal (recurso de reposición) before the same Cámara de Comercio within ten business days of notification under Ley 1437 de 2011 (Código de Procedimiento Administrativo y de lo Contencioso Administrativo). In cases of conflict with a registered trademark, the applicant may obtain a letter of consent from the trademark holder, add a differentiating element to the requested name, or escalate the review to the Superintendencia de Sociedades. A single additional 30-day extension of the reserved name may be requested upon payment of the renewal tariff at the Chamber's discretion; failure to incorporate within the reservation window voids the reservation and requires a fresh application.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A serviced virtual office is permissible for the ISIC 4638 dehydrated spices trading S.A.S. because the activity does not hold a statutory license requiring physical operating premises. The registered address must be a verifiable domicile within a Colombian municipality where the Cámara de Comercio and DIAN notice requirements (Dirección de Notificación Judicial) can be physically fulfilled; a serviced BPO or management-company address with mail handling and legal notification services is commercially acceptable. A pure mailbox-only address with no personnel or reception service is technically registerable but increases the probability of DIAN domicile verification and adverse banking KYC findings.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low risk; approximately 5% to 8% probability of an unannounced inspection during the first operational year by DIAN or the Cámara de Comercio to verify domicile and economic activity. The probability rises to approximately 15% if RUBF filings are late, statutory financial statements are not filed, or invoices contain inconsistent commercial establishment data.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official notary tariff, approximately COP 133,000 for signature and certification of a short document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille of foreign shareholder constitutional documents (three documents)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular fee approximately COP 53,300 per apostille (USD 13–15), three documents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translation of foreign UBO declarations and shareholder corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark USD 15–20 per page; approximately 5 pages

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Accredited provider fee approximately COP 100,000 (USD 25); RUT issuance itself is free

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration in the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUBF)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark in Bogotá or Medellín, USD 400–600 for a standard foreign-owned S.A.S.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Chamber tariff approximately COP 5,000–12,000 per certificate (USD 3–4), three certificates

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Código de Comercio, and Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015; applicable articles governing S.A.S. constitution, private instrument, and registration before the Cámara de Comercio
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered office, integrated with the Registro Único Empresarial (RUES), subject to inspection and oversight by the Superintendencia de Sociedades
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private certificate of incorporation) registered in the Mercantile Registry; must be raised to public deed if real property is contributed
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement for an S.A.S.; capital may be subscribed and paid within two years. If real property is contributed, transfer must be effected by public deed before commercial registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the undersigned sole shareholder approves the incorporation of the Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada under Law 1258 of 2008 and the Commercial Code. RESOLVED, that the subscribed capital set forth in the bylaws is accepted, allocated to the shareholder, and issued as registered shares; unpaid installments are governed by the capital payment schedule. RESOLVED, that the registered office is adopted at [City], Colombia, with the corporate purpose covering the wholesale trade and export of dehydrated vegetables and spices under ISIC 4638. RESOLVED, that the shareholder appoints [Name] as legal representative and approves the bylaws, corporate governance rules, and commencement of Chamber of Commerce, DIAN, and bank formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered office, via RUES Online or the physical registry window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the name homologation application requesting a Certificado de Homologación de Nombre. The Chamber will compare the proposed name against registered companies and protected trademark databases. Once available, request written reservation of the name, which is generally valid for 30 calendar days.
required_dossiers: Photocopy of the incorporator's identification document
Two or three alternative proposed names
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is denied because of similarity, file a revised name application and pay only the new search fee, or submit a written objection to the Chamber if prior trademark rights are held.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Private Act of Incorporation and Bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (only if real property is contributed) and Cámara de Comercio for subsequent registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the bylaws in Spanish containing the corporate name, registered office, corporate object, duration, subscribed capital, share classes, payment terms, legal representative appointment, and internal governance rules. Each initial shareholder signs the private document. If real estate is contributed, the document must be executed as a public deed before a notary.
required_dossiers: Written acceptance of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or Chamber identifies defective clauses, correct the affected provisions and re-present the instrument; if notarization was triggered by real property, a new deed page or amended deed may be required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration in the Mercantile Registry and RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the signed incorporation instrument, RUES form, and attachments with the Chamber of Commerce within one month of execution. The Chamber reviews legal compliance, calculates registration tariffs and the registration tax, and issues the Certificado de Matrícula Mercantil upon successful registration.
required_dossiers: Valid identification of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, the Chamber grants a correction term, typically 30 days; submit the amended document within that term to avoid cancellation of the filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtaining the RUT and NIT from DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN - Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales, MUISCA virtual portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access MUISCA, complete the RUT registration wizard, and enter the company's commercial registration data, ISIC 4638 economic activity, registered address, and legal representative information. DIAN will generate the NIT and RUT certificate electronically once the data are validated against the Chamber records.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects the RUT filing, reconcile discrepancies between Chamber data and DIAN records and submit a rectification through the DIAN corrective form or the nearest DIAN service center.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account Opening and Paid-in Capital Certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Financial institution selected by the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate bank account, deposit the subscribed capital, and obtain a bank certificate confirming the paid-in amount. Retain this certificate in the corporate records as evidence of capital contribution compliance.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional due diligence materials, provide the updated RUES certificate, UBO declaration, and legal representative ID; if rejected, apply to an alternate authorized bank with the same dossier.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Formation Tax and Export Registration Completions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN and Ventanilla Única de Comercio Exterior (VUCE) of the Ministerio de Comercio, Industria y Turismo
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After RUT activation, apply for electronic invoicing authorization under DIAN's facturación electrónica framework. If exporting dehydrated vegetables and spices, register the company in VUCE, validate the HS tariff classification, and obtain the exporter registration code. Complete the annual RUES update and corporate book formalities.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VUCE rejects the exporter registration due to tariff classification mismatches, correct the HS code and resubmit; for DIAN e-invoicing rejection, use the DIAN electronic support channel to correct the invoice configuration.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio, Industria y Turismo through VUCE, with INVIMA for food safety and the local Cámara de Comercio for operational coordination
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Permiso Sanitario de Funcionamiento and Registro Sanitario de Alimentos issued by INVIMA, plus Certificado de Exportación de Alimentos for consignments of dehydrated vegetables and spices

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible - Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) and the local Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 - Registration or permit without full EIA for low-impact dehydration and spice packing; a full EIA Report is required only for large-scale processing with significant atmospheric emissions or high-risk waste streams
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge limits under Resolución 0631 de 2015; atmospheric emissions thresholds for PM10, PM2.5 and VOCs under Resolución 2254 de 2017; hazardous waste manifest obligations under Resolución 1362 de 2007

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety inspection and certificate of the Cuerpo de Bomberos; municipal uso de suelo and structural load review for storage racks; compliance with the Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo (SG-SST) under Resolución 0312 de 2019

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – official national tax and customs authority; electronic portal: www.dian.gov.co, taxpayer platform: Muisca
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity or its local representative must obtain a NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) before commencing taxable activities. Process: (1) appoint a local legal representative; (2) complete registration through DIAN's Muisca portal using a digital certificate; (3) submit the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) application with apotillado/legalized incorporation documents; (4) obtain RUT that evidences NIT and assigns tax obligations; (5) register for VAT (IVA) if required; (6) enable electronic invoicing through DIAN before issuance. For a Colombian S.A.S., NIT is also embedded at Chamber of Commerce incorporation and later validated by DIAN.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not offer a check-the-box regime. The S.A.S. is mandatorily classified as a Colombian resident corporation subject to entity-level taxation. No general hybrid mismatch elections are available. Certain limited elections exist for simplified regimes for individuals and optional VAT responsible-person status; exporters are generally required to register irrespective of elections.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA – Impuesto sobre las Ventas (Value Added Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general monetary turnover threshold applies to corporations. Entities performing taxable activities must register as 'responsables del régimen común'. The simplified regime is only for individuals under 3,500 UVT. A corporate exporter must register for VAT irrespective of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Electronic invoicing is mandatory under DIAN Resolution 000165 of 2023. Invoices must be pre-validated and transmitted to DIAN in real time through authorized software or platforms before purchase delivery. Each invoice requires CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica). Export invoices require the mandatory export support document and are subject to DIAN fiscal clearance validation. API/web service interoperability and digital stamping with DIAN are compulsory.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods qualify for 0% VAT under Article 481 of the Colombian Tax Statute when the goods physically leave Colombia and are sold abroad in foreign currency. The exporter must prove the foreign sale, transport, and customs exit. Input VAT may be refunded or offset subject to DIAN review.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DEX / Declaración de Exportación)
Commercial Invoice issued under electronic invoicing rules
Bill of Lading (BL) or Airway Bill (AWB)
Inward Remittance Certificate or foreign currency repatriation evidence
Electronic export support document submitted to DIAN via Muisca
Purchase and cost documentation supporting input VAT credits
Phytosanitary certificate or export eligibility certificate where applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: False or unjustified export zero-rating claims attract full VAT recovery at 19%, plus moratory interest from the original due date. Improper refunds trigger penalties under Article 648 CIT of 100% to 150% of the excessive claim. Criminal tax evasion sanctions, fines, and imprisonment may apply to legal representatives. DIAN can audit five years retrospectively, seize assets, and freeze bank accounts to recover overstated refunds. Supporting documentation must be retained at least five years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (central bank) and the Ministerio de Hacienda y Crédito Público (Ministry of Finance and Public Credit) jointly administer Colombia's international exchange regime (Régimen Cambiario) under Law 9 of 1991, Decree 1068 of 2015, and Supplemental Circular DCIN-83. The Banco de la República issues mandatory foreign exchange regulations, operates the electronic registration system (Registradora), and licenses authorised foreign exchange intermediaries (bancos comerciales, corporaciones financieras, and sociedades comisionistas de bolsa).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a managed free convertibility regime. Current account transactions — export/import payments, interest, dividends, and contractual settlements — are freely convertible and require only an exchange declaration to an authorised intermediary. Capital account transactions, including foreign direct investment, portfolio inflows, and external borrowing, are convertible but subject to mandatory registration with the Banco de la República via authorised channels. Profit remittances by foreign shareholders are permitted without prior exchange-control authorisation, provided the local entity has filed the corresponding corporate income tax returns and has made the required withholding (10% on dividends paid to non-residents, plus the applicable underlying corporate tax at 33% for FY2024, scheduled to decline to 30% by FY2027 under current law). No surrender of profit remittances is required; funds may be sold in the market or remitted directly in foreign currency through a local bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Exporters of goods must channel export proceeds through the Colombian foreign exchange market within the term specified by the competent authority, which cannot exceed 13 months from the date of the export declaration (DEX). The full FOB value of the export invoice must either be surrendered to an authorised intermediary or credited to a foreign-currency deposit account held at a local authorised bank. The exporter must lodge the applicable exchange declaration (Formulario No. 1 – Declaración de Cambio por Exportaciones) within five (5) business days of payment receipt. Failure to comply may trigger administrative fines from the central bank and suspension from the foreign exchange market.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Corriente (operational) account in COP + Foreign Currency Deposit Account (USD/EUR) for export proceeds
Cuenta Corriente + Cuenta de Ahorros en Moneda Extranjera (USD/EUR) with trade services desk
Operational account in COP + foreign-currency deposit account; dedicated export-finance unit
Operational account and foreign-currency account; regional export-remittance services
Corporate current account and foreign-currency account; structured FX derivative products

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Low. Offshore digital electronic money institutions (EMIs) that lack a Colombian financial licence cannot lawfully maintain deposit accounts or processing rails for Colombian residents. Under Law 2155 of 2021 (FINTECH Law) and the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia regulatory framework, only locally licensed SEDPEs (specialised electronic deposit and payment companies) or full financial entities may offer payment and clearing services. A foreign EMI could act only as a middle-ware platform in partnership with a licensed local bank, but it would have no independent clearing or treasury capacity. Consequently, the treasury blueprint should rely exclusively on regulated Colombian banks for SWIFT, FX, and clearing.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Colombian banks generally require a physical or virtual interview with the legal representative and, for foreign shareholders, the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO). Since 2021, remote onboarding via secure videoconference has become acceptable, provided the corporate documents are certified, apostilled, and translated into Spanish by an official translator, and the bank's compliance officer approves the session. Alternatively, the directors may appoint a local attorney-in-fact through a Colombian notarised power-of-attorney, thereby avoiding the need for the board to appear in person. For an S.A.S., the minimum capital requirement is zero, but a signed and notarised shareholder resolution and the certificate of incorporation and representation (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal) are mandatory for account opening.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Excessive complexity in shareholder structure, such as intermediate holding companies in offshore jurisdictions, causing the bank to suspect undisclosed beneficial ownership.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A full corporate ownership chart identifying every natural person holding 10% or more of shares, accompanied by UBO declarations signed under penalty of perjury, certified copies of organisational documents, and a law-firm opinion on the commercial rationale for the holding structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistent trade documentation — high-value export invoices without corresponding bills of lading, shipping insurance, or port clearance records.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete export packages including the DEX (export declaration), commercial invoices, packing lists, original bills of lading, insurance certificates, and verified SWIFT MT103 payment receipts from the foreign counterparty.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual transaction velocity or frequency that does not align with the stated food-spices export business, triggering PEP or structured-transaction red flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited IFRS financial statements, company bank statements for the past 12 months, purchase orders and trade contracts with named counterparties, and a written liquidity forecast demonstrating seasonal trade-cycle expansion.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Exposure of any transaction to sanctions or embargo lists – because the spice supply chain may touch high-risk jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A professional sanctions-screening report on all counterparties and banks, end-user certificates for each shipment, and a compliance certification issued under the bank's KYC policy confirming no sanctioned countries or parties are involved.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound foreign direct investment (FDI) equity injections must be wired from the foreign investor to the Colombian company's local account in an authorised bank using a standard SWIFT MT103 message. The payment must clearly identify the underlying purpose code 'Inversión Directa en Sociedades – Emisión de Acciones' (available in the Banco de la República's exchange-declaration codifier) to ensure correct registration. Funds delivered in USD or EUR can be immediately converted into COP via the bank's action in the foreign exchange market, or held in a foreign-currency deposit account. The bank will automatically generate the exchange declaration (Formulario No. 1 for exports; Formulario No. 3 for foreign investment) and transmit it to the Banco de la República. The Colombian company must, within 30 calendar days, issue the corresponding shares and file the corporate registration of the investment with the Chamber of Commerce (Cámara de Comercio) to finalise the FDI registration.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For exports of dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper, foreign buyers should remit funds by SWIFT MT103 (Telegraphic Transfer) or under a commercial Letter of Credit (LC) via MT700. The local bank will automatically credit the proceeds to the exporter's foreign-currency account or convert to COP upon submission of the export-related exchange declaration. For import-side payments (e.g., packing materials or processing equipment), the entity must use the same authorised banking channel with an MT103 transfer or a documentary LC, attaching the import declaration (Declaración de Importación) and customs clearance documentation. All outgoing trade payments must be consistent with the underlying trade contract and must be captured by the bank's trade-capture system to demonstrate compliance with Colombian FX regulations.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable Forward (FX Forward) with local banks, settled against a genuine commercial or financial exposure
Non-Deliverable Forward (NDF) denominated in COP vs USD or EUR, available from tier-1 local banks and international providers
Cross-Currency Swap (CCS) converting COP/USD or COP/EUR cash-flow exposures, permitted with banks holding derivatives licences
Vanilla Currency Options (European) with maturities aligned to underlying trade settlement dates
Rolling Forwards and Flexible Forwards to hedge multi-leg trade receivables and payable cycles

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal of Mercantile Registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Chamber of Commerce (Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá / Territorial Chamber in the corporate domicile)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March each year, or per officially published calendar by Superintendencia de Sociedades and local Chambers of Commerce
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment interest on registration tariffs, administrative penalties, temporary suspension of commercial license via Registro Mercantil, and risk of cancellation from the commercial register for continuous non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax and Complementary Declaration (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Determined annually by DIAN Tax Calendar; typically between August and September each year, with exact due date fixed by the last two digits of the taxpayer NIT
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty (sanción por extemporaneidad) of up to 5% on tax assessed or a fixed sum, default interest, penalty for inaccuracy, tax enforcement via coercive collection, and criminal referral for willful tax evasion.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements Filing with Chamber of Commerce (Informe de Estados Financieros)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local Chamber of Commerce acting as registrar)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than one month after financial statements are finally approved by the shareholders' meeting, which must be held within three months following the fiscal year-end, in accordance with the Colombian Commercial Code
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file within the statutory window triggers administrative fines, impediments to issuance of renewed Mercantile Registration certificate, and ineligibility for certain commercial transactions and public procurement participation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Shareholder Meeting and Approval of Financial Statements with Minute Book Recording (Acta de Asamblea de Accionistas)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate record book kept at the registered office; no filed copy unless required by regulator or third parties
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders meeting must be held by 31 March of each year to approve the prior year's financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-approval or missing minute book notation may invalidate financial statements for legal purposes, trigger corporate hygiene penalties, and impede distribution of dividends; persistent failure may expose directors to liability actions and administrative strike-off risk.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit with statutory auditor (Revisor Fiscal) is required for a Colombian S.A.S. when gross revenues or total assets exceed 5,000 times the current Colombian monthly minimum wage (SMMLV), or when the company is subject to public interest rules under Law 43/1990 and Decree 410/1971; entities below this threshold may opt to hire an independent accountant for financial statement certification.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian Financial Reporting Standards (Grupo 1 full IFRS, Grupo 2 IFRS for SMEs, Grupo 3 simplified accounting) as adopted by the Colombian Accounting and Assurance Standards System (DUR 2420 of 2015 and subsequent amendments); the company must apply the standard applicable to its financial profile.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No separate annual UBO declaration is required in Colombia; beneficial ownership (Beneficiarios Finales) data must be registered with the DIAN-managed RUB system (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales) and updated within 15 calendar days of any reportable shareholding or control change. The annual Mercantile Registration renewal implicitly confirms the latest corporate structure and mandates consistency with RUB records.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members / Shareholders (Libro de Registro de Socios o Accionistas)
Register of Directors and Minutes of Shareholders / Board Meetings (Libro de Actas de Asamblea y Junta Directiva)
Minute Book of Representation / Individual Sole Shareholder Decisions (Libro de Actas del Representante Legal)
